rule: Only the user's explicit accept or decline decision changes a review group status.

lesson7-verbstem-structure.acceptedJob: Preserve one verbstem with its real internal boundaries and unified meaning, even when an internal morph's separate meaning is unknown.

lesson7-verbcore-citation.acceptedJob: Make every verb citation preserve its required Valence while keeping the exact carrier realization automatic.

lesson7-class-basis.acceptedJob: Use the stem's licensed class to control its imperfective-perfective relation and show that automatic work as a formula cue.

lesson7-perfective-class-forms.acceptedJob: Form the correct Class A, B, C, or D perfective stem automatically and show the operation as a cue.

lesson7-imperfective-class-forms.acceptedJob: Choose the correct imperfective stem shape from the grammatical surroundings, without asking the user to choose a shape.

lesson7-class-b-perfective-changes.acceptedJob: Send Class B perfectives through the common spelling and sound system automatically and show the resulting grammatical change.

lesson7-variable-class-membership.acceptedJob: Offer the user only Canvas-licensed class alternatives and generate the matching perfective result.

lesson7-class-guidelines-one-four.acceptedJob: Apply class guidelines one through four automatically, while preserving their exceptions and true alternatives.

lesson7-class-guidelines-five-eight.acceptedJob: Apply class guidelines five through eight automatically, using meaning conditions and exact lexical memberships where Canvas requires them.

lesson7-predicate-tables.acceptedJob: Use the selected mood and tense to choose the exact class-conditioned stem and tense carrier automatically.

lesson7-analysis-translation.acceptedJob: Build one complete VNC Result and let Linear Formula, Diagram, and reading guidance explain that same grammar without authorizing it.

lesson7-object-relationship-contrasts.acceptedJob: Keep human, nonhuman, reflexive, and reciprocal relationships distinct, including subject-number and referent-number conditions.
